summary: Blue Water Acquisition Corp. IV (a SPAC) filed an 8-K announcing that on or about May 11, 2026, unit holders may elect to separately trade the Class A ordinary shares and warrants underlying the units. No economic terms, price, premium, or board recommendation are involved; this is an administrative milestone following an IPO. The mechanics involve broker contact with the transfer agent for unit separation. There is no M&A, activist, restructuring, or any special-situation event—only routine post-IPO unit separation. The filing is a routine current report with no special-situation relevance.
